subject: Gold Skulltula token
text: In the Forest Temple, a Gold Skulltula token is located on the top right of the ivy wall in the very first room and requires the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Found: On the top and far-right of the ivy wall in very first room...Kill it and take it's token with the Hookshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula token
text: In the Forest Temple, a Gold Skulltula token is located to the right of the northern door in the large chamber with four torches and requires the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Found: To the right of the northern door in large chamber with four torches...Kill it and take the token with the Hookshot.

subject: Poe Sisters
text: In the Forest Temple, the Poe Sisters appear in the large torch chamber and steal the flames from the torches.

evidence.quote:
Enter the room where the Poe Sisters appear and steal the flames from the
torches.

subject: Northeast courtyard
text: In the Forest Temple northeast courtyard, a chest sits on the high ledge surrounded by a pool of water.

evidence.quote:
Head for the northeast courtyard; it's the courtyard with the Big Deku Baba,
two Octoroks and a high ledge surrounded by a pool of water.  Look on the high
ledge to see a chest.

subject: Gold Skulltula token
text: In the Forest Temple, a Gold Skulltula token is located around the corner from the chest on the upper ledge in the northeast courtyard.

evidence.quote:
Found: On upper ledge in northeast courtyard...Pull yourself up to it with the Hookshot, then look on
the wall around the corner from the chest to see the Gold Skulltula.  Kill it
and take the token with the Hookshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula token
text: In the Forest Temple, a Gold Skulltula token is located high on the wall past the broken pillars in the northwest courtyard, reached from the falling ceiling room.

evidence.quote:
Found: On wall in northwest courtyard...You have to use the upper entrance to the courtyard from the falling ceiling
room to reach this Skulltula....Jump out along these pillars, and at the other end of the pillars
look high on the wall to see a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token
with the Hookshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula token
text: In the Forest Temple, a Gold Skulltula token is located in a small room in the area with the spinning walls and requires the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
Found: In a small room in the area with the spinning walls
Requires: Hookshot...Find the small room with the Gold Skulltula in it, and use the Hookshot to kill
it and take it's token.

subject: Gold Skulltula token
text: In the Fire Temple, a Gold Skulltula token is located in a small room reached by playing the Song of Time to lower a Block of Time in the large fire cavern.

evidence.quote:
Found: In small room reached by the Block of Time in the large fire cavern
Requires: Song of Time...Head for the left side of the room, play the Song of Time to
make the Block of Time come down.  Climb onto the Block of Time and enter the
room.  Destroy the flying floor panels and the Like-Like, and then get the Gold
Skulltula from the rear wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula token
text: In the Fire Temple, a Gold Skulltula token is located behind a bombable wall on the east side of the rolling boulder maze on the second level.

evidence.quote:
Found: In rolling boulder maze, behind bombable wall on east side of the room
Requires: Bombs...Head for the rolling boulder maze on the second level of the Fire Temple, and
go to the east side of the maze.  Find the bombable wall by attacking the walls
until they make an odd noise.  Destroy the wall with a bomb, and take the Gold
Skulltula from the other side.

subject: Bombable wall
text: In the Fire Temple rolling boulder maze, the bombable wall can be found by attacking walls until they make an odd noise.

evidence.quote:
Find the bombable wall by attacking the walls
until they make an odd noise.  Destroy the wall with a bomb, and take the Gold
Skulltula from the other side.

subject: Gold Skulltula token
text: In the Fire Temple, a Gold Skulltula token sits on a wire wall on the second level of the room above the rolling boulder maze, accessible via Pierre and the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
Found: In area above rolling boulder maze, accessible only with the
       Scarecrow's Song
Requires: Hookshot; Scarecrow's Song...The Gold Skulltula sits on a wire wall on the second level
of the next room.

subject: Gold Skulltula token
text: In the Fire Temple, a Gold Skulltula token is found through the door at the top of the room past the upper level of the rolling boulder maze.

evidence.quote:
Found: In room past the upper level of the rolling boulder maze, accessible
       only with the Scarecrow's Song
Requires: Hookshot; Scarecrow's Song...Climb to the top of this room and through the door at the
top.  Kill the Gold Skulltula through the door on the other side.

subject: Pierre
text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song on the upper level of the Fire Temple rolling boulder maze makes Pierre appear on a small platform near the entrance.

evidence.quote:
Play the Scarecrow's Song to
make Pierre appear on that platform, and Hookshot yourself up to him.

subject: Gold Skulltula token
text: In the Fire Temple, a Gold Skulltula token is located on the rear wall of a room with Like-Likes and flying tiles past the totem pole in the entrance room.

evidence.quote:
Found: In a room past the door behind the totem pole in the first room.
Requires: Megaton Hammer...Go through that door, to find another room with Like-Likes
and more flying tiles.  Kill them all, and then get the Gold Skulltula from the
rear wall.

subject: Totem pole
text: In the entrance to the Fire Temple, the Megaton Hammer must be used on the totem pole to access the door on the other side.

evidence.quote:
Use the Megaton Hammer on the totem pole in the entrance to the Fire Temple,
and go through the door on the other side.

subject: Gold Skulltula token
text: In the Ice Cavern, a Gold Skulltula token is located on the left wall as Link enters from the southern door of the giant spinning scythe room.

evidence.quote:
Found: On the south wall in the room with giant spinning scythe.
Requires: Hookshot...The Gold Skulltula is on the
left wall as you enter from the southern door.

subject: Gold Skulltula token
text: In the Ice Cavern, a Gold Skulltula token is located in the northern alcove of the small room east of the spinning scythe room, behind a red-colored wall.

evidence.quote:
Found: In small room to the east of the giant spinning scythe room
Requires: Hookshot; Blue Flame...Use a bottle of Blue Fire to melt the red-colored wall on the east side of the
spinning scythe room.  Run east into the next room, and look for the Gold
Skulltula in the northern alcove.  Use the Hookshot to kill it and take it's
token.

subject: Gold Skulltula token
text: In the Ice Cavern, a Gold Skulltula token is located above the pit to the left upon entering the sliding block puzzle room west of the spinning scythe room.

evidence.quote:
Found: In sliding block puzzle room, above a pit
Requires: Hookshot; Blue Flame...Use a bottle of Blue Fire to melt the red-colored wall on the west side of the
spinning scythe room.  Run west into the sliding block puzzle room, and look
for the Gold Skulltula above the pit to the left as you enter the room.  Use
the Hookshot to kill it and take it's token.
